title: Green Commuter
description: Complete 5 public transit or cycling quests in Pune.

title: Waste Warrior
description: Consistently segregate home waste and avoid single-use plastics.

title: Tree Guardian
description: Plant or adopt trees in Pune urban green zones.

title: Streak Master
description: Maintain an active EcoQuest streak for 7 consecutive days.

title: Eco Champion
description: Reach 1,000 EcoXP and unlock Level 4 Eco Guardian status.
